title: Fantastic Four
synopsis: A mishap in orbit changes four people’s bodies. Ben, now visibly different wherever he goes, must decide what he wants his strength to be for.
verdictRationale: Ben steps between a truck and a stranger. That instinct to protect gives the story moral weight, although Johnny’s reckless flirting often earns him laughs.
ageRationale: The dangling firefighters and Doom burning a hole through a man can frighten younger viewers. Several jokes turn on bodies being undressed.
reflection: Ben wonders if his changed body means God hates him. A Christian family can take his grief seriously and ask what it would mean to sit with him after the crowd goes home.

title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
synopsis: Reed and Sue’s wedding is interrupted as a visitor prepares Earth for destruction. Sue learns why the Silver Surfer agreed to serve Galactus.
verdictRationale: Sue listens to a captive who has helped endanger her planet. Her refusal to give up on his freedom bears fruit when he risks himself for people he once endangered.
ageRationale: Doom disintegrates an officer and Sue is pierced by a spike. The bachelor party includes sustained drinking, suggestive dancing and sexual jokes.
reflection: Sue takes seriously the fear that binds the Surfer to his master. Her mercy makes room for repentance and for the harder work of repairing harm.

title: Fantastic Four
synopsis: Young researchers open a passage to another world. An unauthorized expedition leaves them injured and changed, and their survival eventually depends on working together.
verdictRationale: Reed’s wish to help humanity becomes credible when he takes responsibility for others. The film also dwells on victims’ suffering and shows how quickly adults turn Ben’s strength into a weapon.
ageRationale: Doom makes people’s heads burst, leaving blood on the walls. The injuries during the expedition and Ben’s childhood abuse add distress beyond ordinary superhero fights.
reflection: Reed can imagine a discovery benefiting millions while overlooking the friend who has already paid for it. Repentance begins with attention to the particular person one has hurt.
